items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch of SearchWoot; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and affiliate boundaries. The official Woot documentation confirms API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data; public terms point against those uses. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy jurisdiction treatment, and any affiliate or advertising expansion. No go-live proposal is supported.
